prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop game UI art direction mockup, landscape 16:10, edge to edge application screen, no browser or device frame. This is a personal Italian fully digital cooperative fantasy board game with the atmosphere and staging of a premium turn based computer RPG, built from 2D painted layers rather than real 3D. Original artwork, original fictional demonstration scene. Composition: the entire viewport opens directly onto a lavish painterly isometric forest diorama with a winding path, luminous stream, mossy ruined bridge, ancient trees, ruins and mist; the map occupies 85% of the viewport. A small human ranger hero in a muted green cloak stands left of the bridge, an elf archer and short dwarf wait behind, distant shadow enemies by the ruin. All figures are small readable hand painted 2D sprites, not photorealistic actors. Readable tactical regions have subtle warm ivory perimeter lines over the landscape, no square or hex grid, one legal destination illuminated with amber and a subtle proposed path. Interface: restrained thin top phase strip with exact Italian labels 'FASE AZIONE' and 'Prova grafica'; a quiet top left vertical rail of five small party portraits; bottom left a selected ranger portrait and a short strip of three hand drawn card faces; bottom center three elegant actual buttons labeled exactly 'Viaggia', 'Attacca', 'Interagisci'; bottom right a compact activity log showing only 'Destinazione selezionata'. Cinematic low afternoon light, deep evergreen and blue slate shadows, amber sunlight, crisp ivory UI; light and atmosphere are visible yet every piece and zone is clear. Highest quality original fantasy game art with meaningful negative space for the UI, confident composition, rich scenery with readable path. No marketing hero, website sections, generic dashboard, logos, numeric stat claims, dice, watermark, or copied game screenshots. Text sparse and entirely Italian. One image only. The selected hero is the emotional focus: the bottom left portrait is large and expressive, labeled 'Aragorn', with readable compact labels 'Ruolo', 'Esperienza', 'Equipaggiamento'. Three ability cards are prominent and one is raised as selected. Preserve all terrain legibility. Do not show a D&D level, dice rolls or generic RPG hit point/action point rules.
approval: Il proprietario ha scelto Diorama 2.5D nella conversazione del 23 ottobre 2026.
